title: Tennis: Alex Eala falls to Liu, misses out on Hong Kong title
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala fell short of a second title this year after losing to American Claire Liu in the final of the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open, Sunday at Victoria Park.
